in_hebrew.name: Gawlas
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Gawlas הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Greek word 'Gaulos', meaning 'a warrior'. In Greek mythology, Gaia is the personification of the Earth, and Gawlas may be a derivation of this name, representing a strong connection to the land and nature.
